reason: The marked drum wall likely needs cutting to make the viewing slots.
expectation: The scissors will cut openings in the drum-wall strip.

effect: The wall now has viewing slits; it can likely be formed into a drum.
reaction: The cut was predictable, but it made useful progress.
reason: The seam tape should join the slit wall into a drum shape.
expectation: The tape will secure the wall into a loop.

effect: The slotted wall is now a cylinder, ready for a floor.
reaction: The taped seam was straightforward progress.
reason: The round floor should fit inside the cylinder to complete the drum.
expectation: The floor will attach to the cylinder to form a drum.

effect: The cylinder now has a floor; it needs a support and turning mechanism.
reaction: The drum came together as expected.
reason: The spindle and turning platform should fit the base to support the rotating drum.
expectation: The base will gain a platform on which the drum can turn.

effect: The base now has a turntable, ready to support the drum.
reason: The finished drum should sit on the turntable so it can rotate.
expectation: The drum will mount on the turntable and turn smoothly.

effect: The drum now turns on its upright axle, and its twelve slits pass the viewer's eye; the chapter goal is complete.
reaction: Seeing the separate drum and turntable come together was satisfying, though the empty picture show leaves me curious.

mostWorthwhile.text: Mounting the drum on the turntable was most worthwhile: it brought the pieces together and showed how the drum rotates while its base stays still.

leastWorthwhile.text: Taping the wall and attaching its floor were predictable assembly steps, though they were useful progress.

surprise.text: I expected the drum to turn, but the result made the sequence of twelve narrow windows explicit.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt arbitrary; each piece had a clear place in the construction.

continue.text: Yes. I would like to see how pictures in the slotted drum create movement; this chapter built the mechanism but left the picture show empty.
